details:
The kernel-rt packages provide the Real Time Linux Kernel, which enables fine-tuning for systems with extremely high determinism requirements.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: drm/amdgpu: Fix fence put before wait in amdgpu_amdkfd_submit_ib (CVE-2026-31566)

* kernel: netfilter: nf_queue: hold bridge skb->dev while queued (CVE-2026-52912)

* kernel: Linux kernel: PPPoE memory corruption via stale pointer (CVE-2026-68121)

* kernel: Linux kernel IPVS: Denial of Service due to stale memory references (CVE-2026-80714)

* kernel: nvme-tcp: reject a read that transferred too few bytes (CVE-2026-89480)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
